name: Charles Goerens - § 20
title: REPORT on financing for development – ahead of the Fourth International Conference on Financing for Development in Seville
part_text: Believes that, in many cases, only general debt relief and cancellation of debt, free of economic policy conditions and accepted by all creditors, can put a country back on a sustainable path of financing, instead of deferring debt repayments; stresses the need to develop domestic legislation to enforce private creditor’s participation in debt restructuring deals;
